reason: Wrapping the entire expression evaluation in a broad try/catch that swallows all exceptions (not just casting errors) and silently returns default(T) can mask genuine scripting/workflow errors and change behavior for consumers relying on failures propagating, though it's scoped to a single evaluator and logs the error.
